studies.title: The marine chronometer
studies.caption: John Harrison's H4 keeps time at sea to within seconds a day on a voyage to Jamaica.
studies.prompt: Close three-quarter object study of Harrisons H4 marine timekeeper in1761: a large silver pocket-watch-shaped case, white dial with dark Roman numeral-like marks and delicate hands, hinged outer case open, resting on dark cloth with a plain wooden carrying box. It is a watch, not a later box-mounted marine chronometer.
